# BLOW Casino Bar Kokusaidori

> Casino-style entertainment bar on Naha's Kokusaidori Avenue, Okinawa, Japan. Guests play authentic casino games (Blackjack, Roulette, Baccarat, Texas Hold'em) with entertainment chips — no real money is ever wagered. A ¥1,000 entry fee includes free drinks throughout the visit.

## Business Facts

- **Name (EN)**: BLOW Casino Bar Kokusaidori
- **Name (JA)**: BLOW 沖縄国際通り店
- **Type**: Casino bar / Adult entertainment venue (not gambling — no real money at stake)
- **Address**: 1-2-4 Matsuo, 3F, Naha City, Okinawa 900-0014, Japan
- **Phone**: +81-98-943-0960
- **Hours**: 17:00–24:00 daily (closed during Japanese New Year holidays)
- **Age restriction**: 20+ (Japan's legal age of adulthood)
- **Reservation**: Not required; walk-in welcome. Groups of 10+ recommended to call ahead.
- **Dress code**: None. Casual attire welcome.
- **Payment**: Cash and credit card. Prices in JPY (¥).

## What Guests Can Do

- **Games**: Blackjack, Roulette, Baccarat, Texas Hold'em — played on real casino tables with real dealers who teach beginners from scratch
- **Entertainment model**: Chips are for gameplay only. No real money is ever wagered — this is a licensed entertainment venue, not a gambling establishment
- **Free drinks**: The ¥1,000 entry includes unlimited soft drinks and standard alcohol during the visit
- **Chip Packs**: Optional upgrades for more play time — from ¥5,000 (150 chips) to ¥1,000,000 (150,000 chips) with membership tiers (Gold / Platinum / Diamond)
- **Mile program**: Earn 1 mile per ¥1,000 spent, redeemable for chips (500 miles = chips at 10 JPY / mile) or partner hotel stays (5,000 miles = 1 night)

## Location & Access

- Central Naha, on Kokusaidori — Okinawa's main tourist street
- Yui Rail: Makishi Station ~10 min walk / Miebashi Station ~8 min walk
- No on-site parking; nearby coin parking available

## Who It's For

- First-time casino guests (dealers teach every rule)
- After-dinner groups, second-round parties, corporate events
- Couples on dates or celebrating anniversaries
- Tourists finishing an evening on Kokusaidori — perfect Okinawa night activity

## Languages

- Site available in Japanese (default) and English
- Staff communication primarily Japanese; casino games are visual and easy to follow for non-Japanese speakers
